# Project instructions

Focus only on source code.

Do not analyze image or media files unless explicitly requested.

Ignore:
- *.png
- *.jpg
- *.jpeg
- *.webp
- *.gif
- *.svg
- public/images/**
- src/assets/**
- uploads/**
- node_modules/**
- dist/**
- android/.gradle/**
- android/build/**

For frontend tasks, focus primarily on:
- src/**/*.js
- src/**/*.jsx
- src/**/*.ts
- src/**/*.tsx
- src/**/*.css
- src/**/*.json
- Capacitor configuration
- relevant Android configuration
